sections.heading: How to paraphrase your text
sections.body:
Paste the text you want to rewrite into the box, choose a style, and press Rewrite. The AI reads your text and writes it again in its own words, in the style you picked. It is asked to keep the meaning and the facts, so the rewrite says the same thing in different words.

1. Paste your text into the box.
2. Choose a style: Standard, Simple, More professional, Shorter or Creative.
3. Press Rewrite and wait 1 to 3 seconds.
4. Read the result, then copy it with one click.

**Read the rewrite against your original before you use it.** The AI does not check facts. Names, numbers and dates should match your source.

Paraphrasing helps most when you know what you want to say but the words are not working. Paste the sentence that gives you trouble, try a style, and compare the result with your own version. Keep the version that sounds most like you, and fix the rest by hand.

sections.heading: Pick the style that fits
sections.body:
The style tells the AI what kind of result you want. Each style is a request, so the same text can read differently under two styles. Try two on the same text and keep the one that reads best.

- **Standard** for a general rewrite.
- **Simple** for plainer words.
- **More professional** for work email and reports.
- **Shorter** when the text needs to take less space.
- **Creative** for more playful wording.

Shorter works well for a long paragraph you need to cut down, and Creative works well for a headline or tagline you want to rephrase.

If you are not sure, start with Standard.

sections.heading: What happens to your text
sections.body: The rewrite runs on Google Gemini, on Lazur's servers. Your text is sent there so the AI can rewrite it, and answers usually come back in about 1 to 3 seconds. Do not paste anything you are not allowed to share with an outside service, such as private client details or passwords.

sections.heading: Free use and what it costs
sections.body:
The tool is free and needs no account. You get 3 rewrites a day. After you leave an email, you get 3 more. Each rewrite uses one of them, so check your text and style before you press Rewrite.

If you do this every day, Lazur works in any app on your Mac. Hold two keys and talk, and it types, answers or does the task in whatever app you are in, at [lazur.app](https://www.lazur.app).

sections.heading: What an AI paraphrasing tool does
sections.body:
A paraphrasing tool rewrites a sentence so it says the same thing in different words. An AI tool does this by rewriting the whole sentence, changing the word choice and the sentence shape together. That is different from swapping one word for a synonym, which can leave the sentence stiff.

Use it when a sentence is clumsy or written in the wrong tone for your reader. The rewrite gives you a new starting point, and you still decide what to keep. Students, writers and people who write for work all use it this way, as long as they follow the rules of their school or job.

sections.heading: How to use the AI paraphraser
sections.body:
1. Open [the paraphrasing tool](https://paraphrasing-tool.lazur.app/ai).
2. Paste the text into the Text box. A sentence or a paragraph both work.
3. Choose a style.
4. Press Rewrite and wait 1 to 3 seconds.
5. Copy the result with one click and paste it where you need it.

If the result is too long, too short or too stiff, pick another style and try again. Each rewrite counts toward your daily 3, so check the text and style before you press Rewrite. Read the result before you use it, and change any word that does not sound like you.

sections.heading: Choose the right style for the AI
sections.body:
Each style asks the AI to keep your meaning and facts, but the wording changes with the one you pick. Try two styles on the same text and keep the one that reads best.

- **Standard** for a general rewrite.
- **Simple** for plainer words.
- **More professional** for work email, reports and proposals.
- **Shorter** when you need the text to take less space.
- **Creative** for headlines, taglines and more playful wording.

sections.heading: Check the rewrite before you use it
sections.body:
An AI rewrite is a draft. It can drop a detail, change a number or get a name wrong, so compare it line by line with your original. Read it aloud, and fix anything that does not sound like you.

A rewrite is not a citation. If your text is for school, work or publishing, keep your sources and credit them the way your teacher, editor or guide asks. The tool changes the wording. It does not tell you where an idea came from.

faq.q: Is there a free AI paraphrasing tool?
faq.a: Yes. Lazur's paraphrasing tool is free. You get 3 rewrites a day, and 3 more after you leave an email. You do not need an account.

faq.q: Does the AI paraphrasing tool keep the meaning?
faq.a: It is asked to keep the meaning and facts of your text while it changes the wording. It does not verify them, so compare the rewrite with your original before you use it.

faq.q: Can I copy the rewritten text?
faq.a: Yes. Copy the result with one click and paste it where you need it. The rewrite is plain text, so you can edit it in any app after you paste it.

faq.q: Which paraphrasing style should I choose?
faq.a: Start with Standard. Try Simple for plainer words, More professional for work writing, Shorter to cut length, or Creative for more playful phrasing. Keep the style that reads best.
